name: weyro
description: Weyro monorepo — India automotive repair marketplace (Expo mobile + NestJS API)

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @weyro/api-contracts && npm run build -w @weyro/validation && npm run build -w @weyro/database
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:api
scripts.typecheck: echo "Root workspace: no source files (checked via apps/* and packages/)"
scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck -w @weyro/api-contracts && npm run typecheck -w @weyro/validation && npm run typecheck -w @weyro/database && npm run typecheck -w @weyro/api && npm run typecheck -w @weyro/mobile
